title: Signing with Moe Gale
summary: He signed with Gale after a year or two at the Savoy, valuing a home base.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Right. Okay. And then after that year at Ubangi, you began to travel out more?
Well, yeah, I travelled not too long after that before I went into the Savoy.
I went out for maybe 2 or 3 months. And then, I had to break to go into the Savoy Ballroom. I went into the Savoy during '35, the early part of '35.
And then, Moe Gale, I signed with him, and then he was my personal manager all through the years up until the time he passed.
Okay. So, you signed with Moe Gale in '35?

No. Later. I played in there maybe a year or 2 before I signed. I couldn't make my mind up, you know, about personal managers at that time. He said you'll always have a place to call your home to play. At that time, all bands needed a place where they could get back to. So, I thought it over and I
How was it working with Gale?
Beautiful. No trouble. He did everything he possibly could for me during those years.
